description:
Expand query plan parser coverage from 2 to 6+ platforms to enable the
cross-platform comparison use case. Implement parsers for PostgreSQL, Redshift,
DataFusion, and document platform support clearly.

**Current State**: Only DuckDB (text) and SQLite parsers exist
**Target State**: All major platforms supported with documented compatibility

**Platforms to Add**:
- PostgreSQL (JSON format from EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON))
- Redshift (XML/text format)
- DataFusion (tree format)
- Snowflake (JSON format) - stretch goal
- ClickHouse (tree format) - stretch goal
- BigQuery (custom format handling) - stretch goal
